text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part I · Suits Relating to Accounts
 Section: 1::Three years.
]


For the balance due on a mutual, open and current account, where there have been reciprocal demands between the parties.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runThe close of the year in which the last item admitted or proved is entered in the account; such year to be computed as in the account.
